problem: Production /en/prijzen rendered the Dutch H1 although exact-SHA deployment, pricing structure and release identity were green.
root_cause: The static English cache did not contain an authoritative translation for the exact source H1 'Prijzen voor digitalisering in het mkb'.
fix: Add a small canonical cache patch for the exact source H1.
Keep the production browser proof that rejects the Dutch H1 on /en/prijzen.
Migrate stale i18n and consent regressions to current semantic invariants while retaining exact allowlist membership and fail-closed visible-English browser proof.
prevention: Treat mandatory route hero headings as explicit canonical translation contracts.
Do not consider i18n live based only on html lang or route switching; visible translated copy must also be proven.
failed_approaches: Regression tests hard-coded obsolete implementation syntax (two-script allowlist, literal selectOption calls, old injection variable names) instead of the preserved consent/i18n/browser behavior.

evidence.observed_visible_failure: Dutch pricing H1 remained visible on the English route
evidence.parser_shape: H1 contains separate text nodes around the highlighted span, so cache coverage must include the node-level fragments.

semantic_learning.root_cause: Static i18n resolves DOM text nodes, not the visually concatenated H1 string; a sentence-level cache key alone cannot translate a heading split by markup.
semantic_learning.prevention: Canonical translation patches for styled headings must cover the exact parser text-node sources and remain protected by visible browser assertions.
semantic_learning.proof: The production verifier must observe English visible copy on /en/prijzen and reject the Dutch H1.
